dsh-ssh-hub 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web GUI 多服务器 SSH 终端面板：浮动终端窗口支持标签页、并排组合、广播、宿主侧持久会话，以及密码/私钥/SSH Agent 认证。

posts.en:
dsh-ssh-hub is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Multi-server SSH terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: floating terminal window with tabs, side-by-side groups, broadcast, host-owned persistent sessions, and password/private-key/SSH-agent auth.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ff35329b0f729ec64223.html
